data.description: Version-2 contract: docs/storage-text-format.md. UTF-8/LF sorted JSON per immutable UUID project record, preserved integer API aliases and independently allocated new aliases/numbers, UUID foreign-key references, exact multiline chunks, explicit ordering and deletion tombstones. Preserve authoritative schema-14 project domains and QA evidence. Application request history is excluded from Git: retry results, machine paths, intents and execution ownership remain in ignored checkout-local state shared by desktop/MCP. Reads, fresh no-op requests and retries leave tracked bytes and mtimes unchanged; fresh clones have no request history or cross-clone replay guarantee. Version-1 projects remain read-only byte-stable; the next successful content write upgrades the format and removes legacy request files with recoverable journal deletion, retaining local retry results. Conversions emit version 2 and preserve local retry results within the same checkout. Reuse domain validators through a disposable in-memory SQLite projection. SHA-256 resource fingerprints reject stale content despite equal branch counters. Shared local OS lock, before/after journal and atomic replacement protect cooperating clients and interrupted writes; unexpected external edits block recovery. No Git commands or automatic conflict resolution. Full structural/semantic validation rejects markers, invalid references, collisions, duplicate task/QA link positions and unsafe artifacts. O(project size) materialization; external Git writes must remain idle during publication; directory durability is platform dependent. Task 19 verifies real independent-clone Git scenarios and native WebView2/MCP pull, branch, conflict, no-op and migration flows. Native conflict reload preserves drafts without autosaving discarded edits. Evidence and practical limits: docs/storage-git-collaboration.md.
data.name: Git Text Storage Adapter
data.technology: Rust; canonical JSON records; disposable in-memory relational projection
